title: Problem
description: RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json). Code-specific extension members may appear; clients ignore unknown members.

code.description: Stable Yak error code (design §5.3). Known P1 codes: validation_failed, unauthenticated, forbidden, not_found, already_exists, idempotency_conflict, invalid_transition, newer_message, resync_required, cursor_expired, snapshot_expired, revision_conflict, limit_exceeded, method_not_allowed, precondition_required, temporarily_unavailable. Added by P2 (spec/p2-tasks.md §18): task_claimed, claim_lost, task_claim_active, dependency_cycle, task_root_protected.

request_id.description: Echo of X-Request-Id (client-supplied up to 128 bytes, else server-generated).

header.description: validation_failed: the missing request header. precondition_required (P2): the missing header, If-Match or Yak-Claim-Proof.

latest_message_id.description: newer_message: the thread's current latest message.

reason.description: resync_required: why the read position is no longer valid (policy_changed, history_reset). forbidden (P2): not_assignee, proof_actor_mismatch or missing_capability.

key.description: revision_conflict from a label expectation: the label key.

current.description: revision_conflict from a label expectation: the key's current value, or null when absent.

retained_from_position_available.description: cursor_expired: retained history exists after a snapshot.

task_id.description: P2. already_exists: the thread's existing task (only if readable). task_root_protected: the thread's task. not_found: the offending prerequisite.

epoch.description: P2. task_claimed, claim_lost: the task's current epoch.

state.description: P2. claim_lost: the task's current effective state.

current_state.description: P2. invalid_transition on a task: the current effective state.

hint.description: P2. invalid_transition: what to do instead, e.g. reopen first.

claim_expires_at.description: P2. task_claim_active: when the active claim lapses unless renewed.

cycle.description: P2. dependency_cycle: the cycle path, readable task IDs only (may be partial or empty).

revision.description: P2. revision_conflict from a stale If-Match or expect_brief_revision: the current revision.

limit.description: P2. limit_exceeded: name of the exceeded member of Discovery limits, e.g. max_batch_tasks.

errors.description: P2. Batch rejection (BATCH-003): one entry per failing item; readable IDs only.
